entries.name: LazyComponent
entries.doc: A component is always handed over as a lazy import: `() => import('./Panel')`.
entries.code: export type LazyComponent<Props = {}> = () => Promise<{ default: ComponentType<Props> }>;

entries.name: Surface
entries.code: export type Surface<Props = {}> = { component: LazyComponent<Props> } | { frame: string };

entries.name: defineOverlay
entries.doc: Your own UI over the app: Ruimte draws the header with `title` and a close button, and animates it; you draw the body. `open` answers what `close` was given, or null when a person dismissed it.

BaseContext
entries.doc: What every slot, action and widget is told.

entries.name: SlotAnswer
entries.doc: `false` hides it, `true` shows it, an object also changes what it shows there.
entries.code: export type SlotAnswer = boolean | { title?: string; icon?: string; disabled?: boolean | string; badge?: string; order?: number };

entries.name: Slot
entries.code: export type Slot<Context> = true | ((context: BaseContext & Context) => SlotAnswer);

entries.name: SlotContexts
entries.doc: What each place tells.

entries.name: SlotName
entries.code: export type SlotName = keyof SlotContexts;

entries.name: Slots
entries.code: export type Slots<Place extends SlotName = SlotName> = { [Key in Place]: Slot<SlotContexts[Key]> };

entries.name: ContextOf
entries.code: export type ContextOf<Place extends SlotName> = { [Key in Place]: BaseContext & SlotContexts[Key] }[Place];

entries.name: ActionHandle
defineAction
entries.doc: While `run` is pending, its nodes show a spinner that also stops it through `signal`, and a throw reaches the person. Without `slots` it only shows where a menu puts it, and gets that menu's context. Type it with `defineAction<Context>`.

entries.name: MenuItem
entries.code: export type MenuItem = ActionHandle | 'separator' | { title: string; run(): void; checked?: boolean } | { title: string; items: MenuItem[] };

entries.name: defineMenu
entries.doc: A menu of your own: a submenu in a menu, a dropdown in a bar.
entries.code: export function defineMenu<Place extends SlotName>(menu: { id: string; title: string; icon?: string; slots: Slots<Place>; items: MenuItem[] | ((context: ContextOf<Place>) => MenuItem[]) }): void;

entries.name: defineWidget
entries.doc: Your own React in a slot.
entries.code: export function defineWidget<Place extends SlotName>(widget: { id: string; slots: Slots<Place>; component: LazyComponent<{ context: ContextOf<Place> }> }): void;

defineLanguageServer
entries.doc: Needs `languages.servers`. Adds a server, listed in Settings like one a person added, and started without asking: installing the extension was the approval. Calling it again with the same name changes it, and removing the extension removes it unless a person edited it. Rejects when the command is not on this machine.
entries.code: export function defineLanguageServer(server: { name: string; command: string; args?: string[]; env?: Record<string, string>; languages: string[]; patterns: string[] }): Promise<void>;
